g.text: Branch labour falls in both conditions;
earlier receipt appears only in the higher-fatigue case
Four existing deterministic mechanism cells. HR reuses N/H EDD runs.
This is a mode comparison, not an ADAPTIVE-versus-EDD advantage.
Exposure uses the declared 720h evaluation; receipt uses actual events.
